messages:
Marta (People Ops): Quick question for the group — we're piloting a 'satellite week' option where folks spend 2 weeks/month at a company coworking hub in another state. How should we handle the WFH stipend and payroll reporting for recurring split-week schedules? cc @Evan

Evan (Eng): Thinking of doing this starting May. Is the stipend prorated or do I keep full monthly amount? Also do I need to update homebase?

Priya (Finance): Short answer: depends. Benefits and payroll homebase stay tied to the homebase on file unless the move is >90 days. Stipend can be prorated for recurring partial-month patterns — but we need exact days to calc withholding impact.

Marta (People Ops): Proposed interim rule: for recurring patterns (e.g., 2w/month), we do a calendar-day proration: (days_worked_in_other_state / total_days_in_month) * monthly_stipend. We'll formalize this in an addendum.

Leo (Legal): Flag: repeated presence in another state may create tax or nexus exposure depending on activities. If the role involves hiring, contracting, or sales, that raises risk. For passive presence (just coding in a coworking space) risk is lower but not zero. Please route cases to People Ops so we can run a quick nexus check.

Evan (Eng): Got it. If it's prorated, will 401(k)/benefits or payroll deductions change? Also equipment delivery — can IT ship to the satellite address?

Priya (Finance): Benefits/401k contributions won't change unless you officially change your homebase. Withholding could change if the state requires nonresident filings; we'll advise per-case. For equipment, IT will ship once People Ops approves the address. Submit an IT ticket with your case number.

Marta (People Ops): Action items for employees: 1) submit a People Ops case with expected pattern (e.g., 2 weeks/month), dates, and satellite address; 2) attach any client-facing activities if relevant; 3) indicate whether coworking fees are reimbursed or covered by company. We'll respond within 3-5 business days. :white_check_mark:

PeopleOps-Bot: New case created: #34521 — "Evan: 2w/month Denver satellite". People Ops will triage.

Evan (Eng): Thanks — I'll open the case and include dates. One more quick Q: do I need to sign any attestation about local tax filing responsibility?

Leo (Legal): You may need to complete state nonresident tax forms or attestations depending on the outcome of the nexus check. We'll include guidance in the case response and flag if withholding changes are required.

Marta (People Ops): Closing loop for now: submit the case, we'll run the payroll/tax check and coordinate with Finance & Legal. We'll draft a short FAQ and a split-week addendum template this week. Thanks everyone. :v:
